subtitle: How Clay Seals Held a Kingdom of Learning Together

panels.shot: dramatic low-angle close-up of a hand pressing a carved seal into soft clay with Nalanda’s red-brick monasteries looming in the hazy background
panels.action: Nalanda Seal Keeper in simple monk’s robe presses a round seal into a clay tablet on a wooden desk, kilns and towering brick vihara walls rising behind him in warm afternoon light.

dialogue.text: While Nalanda’s halls rang with debate, silent clay seals guarded its memory and gave its sangha a single, enduring voice.

i18n.hi: जब नालंदा के प्रांगण बहस से गूंजते थे, मौन मिट्टी की मुहरें उसकी स्मृति की रखवाली करतीं और संघ को एक अटूट स्वर देती थीं।

panels.shot: slow aerial sweep over the excavated ruins of Nalanda at sunrise
panels.action: An expansive view of Nalanda’s excavated brick monasteries and temples at dawn, courtyards and pillared halls in long shadows as mist curls over the Magadhan plain.

dialogue.text: In Magadha’s heartland, between the 5th and 12th centuries, Nalanda grew into a great monastery-university, a city of brick amid fields and villages.

i18n.hi: मगध के हृदय में, पाँचवीं से बारहवीं सदी के बीच, नालंदा एक विशाल विहार–विश्वविद्यालय बना, खेतों और गाँवों के बीच ईंटों का नगर।

panels.shot: medium shot at ground level inside a bustling Nalanda courtyard
panels.action: Monks and students in varied robes cross a busy courtyard between brick ranges; some carry palm-leaf bundles, others hurry toward a pillared lecture hall, while novices sweep and fetch water.

dialogue.text: We remember its debates, its teachers, the hum of recitation. Yet such a vast sangha could not live on ideas alone.

i18n.hi: हमें उसकी बहसें याद हैं, उसके आचार्य, पाठ की गुनगुनाहट। पर इतना बड़ा संघ केवल विचारों पर नहीं चल सकता था।

panels.shot: intimate interior medium shot in a small records room
panels.action: Inside a modest brick chamber, Nalanda Seal Keeper sits cross-legged by a low desk, palm-leaf strips before him, shelves of clay tablets and baskets of dried leaves lining the walls.

dialogue.text: Food had to arrive, gifts be recorded, disputes settled, promises remembered. Within the cloisters, quiet stewards and scribes carried this hidden work.

i18n.hi: अन्न आना था, दान लिखे जाते थे, झगड़े सुलझते थे, वचन याद रखे जाते थे। भीतर की गलियों में, शांत प्रबंधक और लेखक यह गुप्त काम संभालते थे।

panels.shot: close-up on hands preparing a sealing
panels.action: Close on Nalanda Seal Keeper’s hands as he rolls a tiny lump of damp clay, presses it over a palm-leaf cord, then reaches for a carved sealing die resting nearby.

dialogue.text: Most of their palm-leaf records have vanished. But their clay sealings, hardened by accident or fire, remained buried in the earth.

i18n.hi: उनकी अधिकांश ताड़पत्र पांडुलिपियाँ गायब हो गईं। पर संयोग या आग से पकी उनकी मिट्टी की मुहरें धरती में दबी रह गईं।

panels.shot: tight close-up as the seal meets the clay
panels.action: The carved face of a round seal, with a tiny stupa and script, presses firmly into the soft clay on a bound palm-leaf bundle, the monk’s fingers steady and deliberate.

dialogue.text: On these small discs the sangha stamped its name, its claim, its consent: the ‘arya-bhikshu-sangha of the great Nalanda monastery’ made visible.

i18n.hi: इन छोटे चक्रों पर संघ ने अपना नाम, अपना दावा, अपनी सहमति अंकित की: ‘महान नालंदा विहार का आर्य भिक्षु संघ’ सबकी आँखों के सामने।

panels.shot: archaeological time-split: layered cutaway from ancient room to modern excavation trench
panels.action: A cutaway image shows an ancient storeroom collapsing over sealed bundles; below, in another layer, modern archaeologists in hats carefully lift terracotta seals from the soil with brushes.

dialogue.text: Centuries later, when the Archaeological Survey dug here, they found hundreds of such seals and sealings in the debris of fallen monasteries.

i18n.hi: सदियों बाद, जब पुरातत्त्व विभाग ने यहाँ खुदाई की, तो गिरी हुई विहारों के मलबे में उन्हें सैकड़ों ऐसी मुहरें और शिलमोहरें मिलीं।

panels.shot: macro shot of a terracotta seal on an archaeologist’s palm
panels.action: A weathered terracotta seal rests on a modern archaeologist’s dusty palm, its stupa motif and faint Nāgarī letters clearly visible under slanting light.

dialogue.text: Hiranand Sastri patiently read their worn letters, cataloguing formulae that named the Nalanda sangha as a corporate body with its own official mark.

i18n.hi: हीरानंद शास्त्री ने धैर्य से घिसे अक्षर पढ़े, उन वाक्यों की सूची बनाई जो नालंदा संघ को अपने मुहर वाले संगठन के रूप में पहचानते थे।

panels.shot: medium shot of a sangha council in a hall
panels.action: In a dim brick hall, senior monks sit in a semicircle on low platforms; Nalanda Seal Keeper kneels respectfully at the edge, holding a palm-leaf document and a clay sealing ready.

dialogue.text: These seals did not belong to a king’s chancery. They spoke for the community itself, used when the sangha acted together, accepted a gift, or answered a claim.

i18n.hi: ये मुहरें किसी राजा के दरबार की नहीं थीं। ये सीधे समुदाय की आवाज थीं, जब संघ मिलकर काम करता, दान स्वीकारता या किसी दावे का उत्तर देता।

panels.shot: medium close-up of a deliberating elder handing a document
panels.action: An elderly abbot with serene face extends a palm-leaf document toward Nalanda Seal Keeper, who bows to receive it, other monks watching with calm attention.

dialogue.speaker: Abbot
dialogue.text: Let the sangha’s seal show that we have agreed as one.

i18n.hi: संघ की मुहर दिखाए कि हम सबने एक स्वर में सहमति दी है।

panels.shot: medium shot in a storeroom with labeled baskets and jars
panels.action: Nalanda Seal Keeper stands in a cool storeroom, stacking sealed palm-leaf bundles in bamboo baskets, some marked by small clay tags hanging from cords around jars and chests.

dialogue.text: Clay tags on baskets, jars, and documents marked what belonged to the monastery, which gifts went where, which obligations the sangha had accepted.

i18n.hi: टोकरी, घड़ों और कागज़ों पर लगी मिट्टी की टैग बताती थीं क्या विहार का है, कौन सा दान कहाँ जाएगा, कौन सी जिम्मेदारी संघ ने स्वीकार की है।

panels.shot: medium shot at a gatehouse with villagers
panels.action: At a simple gatehouse, villagers offer baskets of grain; Nalanda Seal Keeper, seated at a low desk, notes something on a palm leaf and applies a clay seal to a thin tally cord.

dialogue.text: Villagers brought rice, oil, cloth. The sangha recorded these offerings, not with ink alone but with seals that authenticated the transaction.

i18n.hi: गाँव वाले चावल, तेल, कपड़ा लाते थे। संघ इन भेंटों को दर्ज करता, सिर्फ स्याही से नहीं, मुहरों से जो लेन-देन को सच ठहराती थीं।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder shot of the seal keeper examining different seal faces
panels.action: From behind Nalanda Seal Keeper, we see an array of round seals laid on a mat, each with slight variations of inscription and emblem, as he selects one with careful attention.

dialogue.text: Some seals repeated standard formulae. Others added personal names or images, hinting at different offices or donors, all tied back to the greater Nalanda monastery.

i18n.hi: कुछ मुहरें एक तय वाक्य दोहराती थीं। कुछ में नाम या चित्र जुड़ते थे, अलग–अलग पदों या दाताओं का संकेत देते, फिर भी सब महान नालंदा विहार से जुड़े हुए।

panels.shot: medium shot of the seal keeper with an itinerant monk-messenger
panels.action: In a shaded verandah, an itinerant monk with travel-worn robe receives a sealed palm-leaf packet from Nalanda Seal Keeper, both bowing slightly to each other.

dialogue.text: Some sealed bundles went outward, carried by monks toward patrons, other monasteries, and distant courts. The seal made the voice of Nalanda recognizable far beyond its walls.

i18n.hi: कुछ मुहरबंद गठरियाँ बाहर जातीं, भिक्षुओं के साथ दानदाताओं, दूसरे विहारों और दूर दरबारों तक। मुहर ने नालंदा की आवाज़ दीवारों के पार भी पहचान योग्य बना दी।

panels.shot: subtle time transition shot: same room, later century, blackened and ruined
panels.action: The same records room appears charred and collapsed, roof beams fallen; a few clay seals lie half-buried among ash and broken brick, as if time has frozen after catastrophe.

dialogue.text: Fire and ruin later swept the monasteries. Palm-leaves turned to ash, but clay, once baked by the same heat, survived as stubborn witnesses.

i18n.hi: आग और विनाश ने बाद में विहारों को बहा दिया। ताड़पत्र राख हो गए, पर वही तपिश से पकी मिट्टी ज़िद्दी गवाह बनकर बची रही।

panels.shot: modern-day lab close-up of a scholar studying a seal under magnification
panels.action: In a modern conservation lab, a scholar peers through a magnifier at a Nalanda seal, notebooks and reference plates open nearby, bright lamps illuminating the tiny script.

dialogue.text: From these fragments, scholars like Hartmut Scharfe and Frederick Asher traced how the Nalanda sangha governed itself as an enduring institution.

i18n.hi: इन टुकड़ों से, हार्टमुट शार्फे और फ़्रेडरिक एशर जैसे विद्वानों ने देखा कि नालंदा संघ खुद को एक स्थायी संस्था की तरह कैसे चलाता था।

panels.shot: split-frame comparing seal impression and reconstructed inscription line
panels.action: On one side, a worn seal impression with its stupa motif; on the other, a careful ink sketch of the same, with clear Nāgarī letters spelling out the Nalanda monastery’s formal name.

dialogue.text: The text is simple, but its meaning is deep: it shows a community that could act collectively, own property, and authenticate its decisions without a king’s hand on every line.

i18n.hi: शब्द सादे हैं, अर्थ गहरा है: यह उस समुदाय को दिखाता है जो मिलकर काम कर सकता था, संपत्ति रख सकता था, और हर फ़रमान पर राजा की मुहर बिना भी अपने फैसले साबित कर सकता था।

panels.shot: soft close-up of the seal keeper’s thoughtful face, mid-action
panels.action: Nalanda Seal Keeper pauses in his work, looking up from a fresh sealing toward the open courtyard, his face calm yet intent, as students pass in the distance.

dialogue.speaker: Nalanda Seal Keeper
dialogue.text: Debate ends with the bell. This record will outlast us all.

i18n.hi: बहस घंटी पर खत्म होगी। यह लेखा हम सब से ज़्यादा देर तक बोलेगा।

panels.shot: wide contemplative shot of Nalanda’s ruins dissolving into their ancient form
panels.action: The ruined brick mounds of Nalanda slowly dissolve into an imagined vision of the complex alive again, with Nalanda Seal Keeper’s hand and seal faintly superimposed in the foreground.

dialogue.text: Nalanda’s silent seals remind us that great worlds of thought endure only when communities learn to speak together, to remember together, and to leave their mark with care.

i18n.hi: नालंदा की मौन मुहरें याद दिलाती हैं कि विचारों की बड़ी दुनिया तभी टिकती है जब समुदाय साथ बोलना सीखें, साथ याद रखें, और अपना निशान संभालकर छोड़ें।

subtitle_i18n.en: How Clay Seals Held a Kingdom of Learning Together
subtitle_i18n.hi: कच्ची मुहरों ने कैसे ज्ञान का साम्राज्य जोड़े रखा
